en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large inscribed Chinese stone stele (tablet) beside a waterway, with a man standing next to it. The printed caption below the photo reads "Tablet of the Jews K'aifengfu." The reverse has a multilingual "POSTKARTE / Carte postale / Cartolina postale / Post card / ОТКРЫТОЕ ПИСЬМО," the publisher line "CHAS. F. GAMMON PHOTO SERIES. NO. 233." and Japanese "郵便はがき."
